vectors.name: valid inactive template
vectors.workflow:
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jitwark/sfscanner/.github/actions/scan@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
        with:
          path: workflows

vectors.name: separated sarif upload job
vectors.workflow:
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jitwark/sfscanner/.github/actions/scan@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
        with:
          path: workflows
  upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: scan
    permissions:
      security-events: write
    steps:
      - uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@cdf488f595d80d6e07e03d4674febd5ab45fa938
        with:
          sarif_file: n8n-scan.sarif
